name: Scan and Push — Interactive Honeycomb Scanner Protocol v2.0
description: Interactive protocol for scanning all honeycombs with Symbiosis Guard integration, offering multiple scan modes and result views, then pushing updated registry to GitHub.

interactive_menu.description: When protocol is activated, the SR presents this menu to the Gardener.

options.name: Базовое (scan)
options.description: Стандартное сканирование: валидация структуры хонейкомбов и обновление реестра

options.name: Полная проверка (--full-check)
options.description: Все проверки: задачи, Ахимса, дедлайны, целостность

options.name: Только задачи (--validate-tasks)
options.description: Проверяет файлы задач на валидность, полноту и дедлайны

options.name: Только Ахимса (--ahimsa)
options.description: Ищет шум, дубли и устаревшие файлы в хонейкомбах

options.name: Только дедлайны (--deadlines)
options.description: Мониторит просроченные и предстоящие дедлайны в задачах и дорожных картах

options.name: Только целостность (--integrity)
options.description: Проверяет ссылки между хонейкомбами и навигационные связи

result_options.name: Краткий отчёт (scan_state.json)
result_options.description: Статус, количество ошибок/предупреждений, сводка по Стражу Симбиоза

result_options.name: Полный отчёт (registry.json)
result_options.description: Все детали по каждому модулю, включая health.symbiosis_guard

result_options.name: Оба отчёта
result_options.description: Показать и краткий, и полный отчёты

what_scanner_does.scan_target: All folders inside honeycombs/ that contain index.json
what_scanner_does.change_detection: MD5 hash comparison with previous scan_state.json

symbiosis_guard.task_validator: Validates structure, fields, statuses, and deadlines of tasks
symbiosis_guard.ahimsa_filter: Detects noise, duplicates, stale files, and broken links

sections.content.registry.honeycombs: Array of all hives with metadata
sections.content.registry.health.symbiosis_guard: Detailed results from all Symbiosis Guard modules

sections.symbiosis_guard: Summary status: status, errors_count, warnings_count, expired_tasks, noise_files, broken_links

full_cycle_blocks.basic: python honeycombs/registry/honeycomb_scanner.py scan && git add honeycombs/registry/registry.json honeycombs/registry/scan_state.json && git commit -m "feat: scan honeycombs — $(python3 -c "import json; f=open('honeycombs/registry/registry.json'); d=json.load(f); print(d['content']['registry']['statistics']['total_honeycombs'])") hives found, 0 errors" && git pull --rebase origin main && git push
full_cycle_blocks.full_check: python honeycombs/registry/honeycomb_scanner.py scan --full-check && git add honeycombs/registry/registry.json honeycombs/registry/scan_state.json && git commit -m "feat: full health check — $(python3 -c "import json; f=open('honeycombs/registry/registry.json'); d=json.load(f); print(d['content']['registry']['statistics']['total_honeycombs'])") hives found, $(python3 -c "import json; f=open('honeycombs/registry/scan_state.json'); d=json.load(f); print(d.get('symbiosis_guard', {}).get('errors_count', 0))") guard errors" && git pull --rebase origin main && git push

verification.method: Check scan_state.json via RAW URL or API for 'symbiosis_guard' section

steps.action: SR presents interactive menu to Gardener
steps.details: Shows scan type options (1-6) and asks for input

steps.action: SR receives Gardener's choice and runs the selected scan command
steps.details: Uses the corresponding flag from scanner.commands

steps.action: SR checks scan results in logs and output files
steps.note: Look for 'SCAN COMPLETE', 'SYMBIOSIS GUARD STATUS', 'Errors: N, Warnings: M'

steps.action: SR presents result options to Gardener
steps.details: Shows result view options (1-3) and asks for input

steps.action: SR receives Gardener's choice and fetches the corresponding file(s) via API
steps.details: Uses GitHub API to get scan_state.json and/or registry.json

steps.action: SR displays the report(s) to Gardener
steps.note: Shows summary for scan_state, full details for registry

steps.action: SR adds updated files to git
SR commits with dynamic message based on scan type
steps.command: git commit -m "feat: scan honeycombs — X hives found, Y guard errors"
git pull --rebase origin main && git push
Check scan_state.json for updated 'last_scan' timestamp and 'symbiosis_guard' status

notes: Scanner v2.0.0 integrates Symbiosis Guard modules
All new honeycombs are registered as 'new_honeycombs'
Symbiosis Guard results are in 'symbiosis_guard' (scan_state) and 'health.symbiosis_guard' (registry)
If Symbiosis Guard errors > 0 — review the detailed report in registry.json
Registry and scan_state are the single source of truth about system state
Scanner does NOT auto-push — git commands are required
